statement:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ),
  AntitoneOn f (Icc 1 (1 + ↑n)) →
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f (1 + ↑(k + 1)) ≤ ∫ (x : ℝ) in 1..1 + ↑n, f x ∧
      ∫ (x : ℝ) in 1..1 + ↑n, f x ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f (1 + ↑k)

goal.text:
∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f (1 + ↑(k + 1)) ≤ ∫ (x : ℝ) in 1..1 + ↑n, f x ∧
  ∫ (x : ℝ) in 1..1 + ↑n, f x ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f (1 + ↑k)
